# Kettle

Customer support that reads the manual for you

Kettle drafts answers from your own docs and tickets, and hands the hard ones to a human with context.

## Features

### Answers from your docs

Grounded in your content, with links.

### Smart handoff

Humans get the history, not a blank box.

### Quality scoring

See which answers customers actually liked.

## Who it is for

Support teams.

## Pricing

Starts free. Team plans from $29 per month.
